E_normalization_factors <- c(

            E_ionizing_radiation = 4220.16339014993,
            E_ozon_formation = 40.8591977347772,
            E_particulate_matter = 0.000595366821125478,
            E_non.carcinogenic_toxicity = 0.000128735735008072,

            E_marine_eutrophication = 19.5451815519191,
            E_terrestrial_eutrophication = 176.754999788942,
            E_freshwater_ecotoxicity = 56716.5863370596,
            E_land_use = 819498.182923031,
            E_water_use = 11468.7086407597,
            E_energy_use = 65004.2596640165,
            E_mineral_use = 0.0636226152369547)

E_scientific_weights <- c(
            E_climate_change = 0.2106,
            E_ozon_depletion = 0.0631,
            E_ionizing_radiation = 0.0501,
            E_ozon_formation = 0.0478,
            E_particulate_matter = 0.0896,
            E_non.carcinogenic_toxicity = 0.0184,
            E_carcinogenic_toxicity = 0.0213,
            E_land_water_acidification = 0.062,
            E_freshwater_eutrophication = 0.028,
            E_marine_eutrophication = 0.0296,
            E_terrestrial_eutrophication = 0.0371,
            E_freshwater_ecotoxicity = 0.0192,
            E_land_use = 0.0794,
            E_water_use = 0.0851,
            E_energy_use = 0.0832,
            E_mineral_use = 0.0755)

E_personal_weights <- c(
            E_climate_change = 0.15,
            E_ozon_depletion = 0.1,
            E_ionizing_radiation = 0.1,
            E_ozon_formation = 0.05,
            E_particulate_matter = 0.05,
            E_non.carcinogenic_toxicity = 0.05,
            E_carcinogenic_toxicity = 0.05,
            E_land_water_acidification = 0.05,
            E_freshwater_eutrophication = 0.05,
            E_marine_eutrophication = 0.05,
            E_terrestrial_eutrophication = 0.05,
            E_freshwater_ecotoxicity = 0.05,
            E_land_use = 0.05,
            E_water_use = 0.05,
            E_energy_use = 0.05,
            E_mineral_use = 0.05)

# Multiplying normalization and weighting factors, following PEF methodology
E_factors_scientific_clean= 1000* E_scientific_weights / E_normalization_factors 
E_factors_personal_clean = 1000* E_personal_weights / E_normalization_factors

# Aggregation into single scores
score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS <- c(as.matrix(score_calculation_db[, names(E_factors_scientific_clean)]) %*% E_factors_scientific_clean)

score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS <- c(as.matrix(score_calculation_db[, names(E_factors_personal_clean)]) %*% E_factors_personal_clean)



# =============== Min-max Normalization =============
# ======Scientific=========
# Choose "outlier" treshold
upper_threshold <- 4  # adjust this to your needs

# compute min excluding outliers (values below threshold are ignored)
max_no_outlier <- max(score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS[score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS <= upper_threshold], na.rm = TRUE)
min_val        <- min(score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS, na.rm = TRUE)

score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS_MMnorm <- pmax(
  (1-(score_calculation_db$E_scientific_SS - min_val) / (max_no_outlier - min_val)), 0)

# =======Personal==========

# compute min excluding outliers (values below threshold are ignored)
max_no_outlier <- max(score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS[score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS <= upper_threshold], na.rm = TRUE)
min_val        <- min(score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS, na.rm = TRUE)

score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS_MMnorm <- pmax(
  (1-(score_calculation_db$E_personal_SS - min_val) / (max_no_outlier - min_val)),  0 )

## Compute aggregate single scores

```{r}

# dimension-level weights
overall_scientific_weights <- c(AW_scientific_SS_MMnorm = 0.25, E_scientific_SS_MMnorm = 0.25, S_scientific_SS_MMnorm = 0.25, H_scientific_SS_MMnorm = 0.25)
overall_personal_weights <- c(AW_personal_SS_MMnorm = 0.1, E_personal_SS_MMnorm = 0.1, S_personal_SS_MMnorm = 0.1, H_personal_SS_MMnorm = 0.7)

# check if weights sum up to 1
if (round(sum(overall_scientific_weights)) != 1) {print("ERROR: scientific dimension weights don't sum up to 1")}
if (round(sum(overall_personal_weights)) != 1) {print("ERROR: personal dimension weights don't sum up to 1")}

# Aggregation into overall single scores
score_calculation_db$overall_scientific_SS <- c(as.matrix(score_calculation_db[, names(overall_scientific_weights)]) %*% overall_scientific_weights)
score_calculation_db$overall_personal_SS   <- c(as.matrix(score_calculation_db[, names(overall_personal_weights)]) %*% overall_personal_weights)

```



# Algorithm

# Setup

```{r}
alg_db <- score_calculation_db %>%
  select(food_product, SAFAD_L1_cat, SAFAD_L2_cat, TH_code,overall_scientific_SS, overall_personal_SS) %>%
  filter(!is.na(overall_scientific_SS))

# --- Weights for the weighted average (step 3) ---
weight_personal  <- 0.6
weight_scientific <- 0.4

# --- Initialize the three new columns ---
alg_db$alt_best_personal  <- NA
alg_db$alt_best_scientific <- NA
alg_db$alt_best_combined   <- NA

# large, medium or small substitutability

large <- c("x", "m", "v")
medium <- c("x", "m")
small <- c("x")
```

## Choose level of substitutability:

```{r}

# CHOOSE substitutability here
level <- small
```

## Algorithm implementation

```{r}
# --- Main loop ---
for (i in 1:nrow(alg_db)) {
  
  product_A <- alg_db[i, ]
  subcategory_A <- product_A$SAFAD_L2_cat # replace with your actual column name
  
  # Step 1: select relevant products based on matrix_A
  # get all categories that are compatible with category_A
  compatible_categories <- rownames(matrix_A)[matrix_A[, subcategory_A] %in% level]

  step1_relevant <- alg_db[alg_db$SAFAD_L2_cat %in% compatible_categories, ]
  
  # Step 2: keep only products with overall_scientific_score >= product_A
  step2_more_sustainable <- step1_relevant[step1_relevant$overall_scientific_SS >= product_A$overall_scientific_SS, ]
  

  # Step 3: if no relevant products found, skip
  if (nrow(step2_more_sustainable) == 0) next

  # compute weighted average score
  step2_more_sustainable$combined_SS <- 
    weight_personal   * step2_more_sustainable$overall_personal_SS   +
    weight_scientific * step2_more_sustainable$overall_scientific_SS
  
  # select best for each criterion
  best_personal   <- step2_more_sustainable[which.max(step2_more_sustainable$overall_personal_SS),   ]
  best_scientific <- step2_more_sustainable[which.max(step2_more_sustainable$overall_scientific_SS), ]
  best_combined   <- step2_more_sustainable[which.max(step2_more_sustainable$combined_SS),           ]
  
  # Step 4: store the results on the row of product_A
  alg_db$alt_best_personal[i]   <- best_personal$food_product    # replace with your product ID column
  alg_db$alt_best_scientific[i] <- best_scientific$food_product 
  alg_db$alt_best_combined[i]   <- best_combined$food_product 

}

```


# Data analysis

# Results of algorithm
```{r}
# products most recommended as alternatives 
alg_db %>% count(alt_best_scientific) %>% arrange(desc(n))
alg_db %>% count(alt_best_personal) %>% arrange(desc(n))
alg_db %>% count(alt_best_combined) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```


## Scores by category


```{r}
#plot name number
pltnb <- 4


#temporary variable
score_calculation_db$H_scientific_SS <- score_calculation_db$H_scientific_SS_MMnorm

# --- 1. RESHAPE DATA TO LONG FORMAT ---
# Before normalization
scores_raw <- score_calculation_db %>%
  select(food_product, TH_code, SAFAD_L1_cat, SAFAD_L2_cat,
         E_scientific_SS, AW_scientific_SS, S_scientific_SS, H_scientific_SS) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(E_scientific_SS, AW_scientific_SS, S_scientific_SS, H_scientific_SS),
               names_to = "dimension",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(type = "Raw")

# After normalization
scores_norm <- score_calculation_db %>%
  select(food_product, TH_code, SAFAD_L1_cat, SAFAD_L2_cat,
         E_scientific_SS_MMnorm, AW_scientific_SS_MMnorm, 
         S_scientific_SS_MMnorm, H_scientific_SS_MMnorm) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(E_scientific_SS_MMnorm, AW_scientific_SS_MMnorm,
                        S_scientific_SS_MMnorm, H_scientific_SS_MMnorm),
               names_to = "dimension",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(type = "Normalized",
         dimension = gsub("_MMnorm", "", dimension))  # harmonize dimension names


# overall_scores
scores_overall <- score_calculation_db %>%
  select(food_product, TH_code, SAFAD_L1_cat, SAFAD_L2_cat, overall_scientific_SS) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = overall_scientific_SS,
               names_to = "dimension",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(type = "Normalized",
         dimension = "_Overall")

# Combine both
scores_all <- bind_rows(scores_raw, scores_norm, scores_overall)



# Clean up dimension names for display (remove "_scientific_SS")
scores_all <- scores_all %>%
  mutate(dimension = gsub("_scientific_SS", "", dimension)) %>%
  mutate(SAFAD_L1_cat = recode(SAFAD_L1_cat,
    "Drinking water (water without any additives except carbon dioxide; includes water ice for consumption)" = "Drinking water",
    "Fish and other seafood (including amphibians, reptiles, snails and insects)" = "Fish and other seafood",
    "Meat and meat products (including edible offal)" = "Meat and meat products",
    "Non-alcoholic beverages (excepting milk based beverages)" = "Non-alcoholic beverages",
    "Vegetables and vegetable products (including fungi)" = "Vegetables and vegetable products", 
    "Composite food (including frozen products)" = "Composite food"
  ))


# --- 2. SUMMARY TABLE PER L1 CATEGORY ---

summary_table <- scores_all %>%
  group_by(SAFAD_L1_cat, dimension, type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean   = round(mean(score,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median = round(median(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd     = round(sd(score,     na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    min    = round(min(score,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    max    = round(max(score,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)


# --- 3. BOXPLOTS: one plot per dimension, raw vs normalized side by side ---

dimensions <- c("E", "AW", "S", "H")

for (dim in dimensions) {
  
  plot_data <- scores_all %>% filter(dimension == dim)
  
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = SAFAD_L1_cat, y = score, fill = SAFAD_L1_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_y") +  # free_y because raw and norm have different scales
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", dim, "scores by food category"),
      x     = "Food category (L1)",
      y     = "Score",
      fill  = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"  # remove legend since x axis already shows categories
    )
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("boxplot_",dim, "_", pltnb, ".png"), p, width = 12, height = 8)

}
  

plot_data_norm <- scores_all %>% 
  filter(type == "Normalized")

p_all_dim <- ggplot(plot_data_norm, aes(x = dimension, y = score, fill = dimension)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ SAFAD_L1_cat)+    #, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized scores across all 4 dimensions (and overall score) by food category",
    x     = "Dimension",
    y     = "Normalized score",
    fill  = "Dimension"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_all_dim)

ggsave(paste0("boxplots_all_dim_by_category_", pltnb, ".png"), p_all_dim, width = 16, height = 12)
  
    
#remove the temporary H_scientific_SS as this score doesn't have any real meaning (it's the nutri-score)
score_calculation_db <- select(score_calculation_db,-H_scientific_SS)
```
